title: Essence Moraira
name: Essence
sub: Four architect-designed villas on a Mediterranean hillside, each turned to the sea.
thesis_h: A small collection, built to the land it sits on.
thesis_lede: Four homes by architect José Giner Ivars, set on their own plots above Moraira with open views to the Mediterranean. Every villa here is drawn from its real floorplans and placed on the true terrain — not an impression, the actual site.

villas.name: Villa I
villas.blurb: The western villa, opening down its own terrace toward the water. A stone base grounds the cream volumes; the living level runs as one glazed ribbon to the sea.

villas.name: Villa II
villas.blurb: Compact and vertical, stacked for privacy. The upper floor sets back over a shaded ground level, framing the horizon from every principal room.

villas.name: Villa III
villas.blurb: The most sheltered of the four, folded into the slope. Floating roof planes and a full-width terrace hold the sea view low and wide.

villas.name: Villa IV
villas.blurb: The largest home — a long, single-storey-reading mass with a generous glazed frontage, a garage wing and the development’s widest terrace.

film_lede: Each home rendered on the real Moraira terrain — the exact hillside, the exact plots, the actual sea aspect. The same twin produces a film for every villa.
foot_h: Brought to life before a stone is laid.
twin_note: Every image on this page is generated from the development’s own architectural drawings and IGN LiDAR terrain — real footprints, real plots, real sea aspect. The same model renders stills, films and an interactive walkthrough for each home.
